question: Please help me find the film category with the highest total rental hours in cities where the city's name either starts with "A" or contains a hyphen.
sql:
-- Get the single category with highest total rental hours
SELECT 
    c.name AS category_name,
    SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.return_date - r.rental_date)) / 3600.0) AS total_rental_hours
FROM rental r
JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
JOIN film_category fc ON i.film_id = fc.film_id
JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id
JOIN customer cust ON r.customer_id = cust.customer_id
JOIN address a ON cust.address_id = a.address_id
JOIN city ci ON a.city_id = ci.city_id
WHERE ci.city LIKE 'A%' OR ci.city LIKE '%-%'
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY total_rental_hours DESC
LIMIT 1

{"sql": "-- Build the full query: total rental hours per category for cities starting with 'A' or containing hyphen
SELECT 
    c.name AS category_name,
    SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.return_date - r.rental_date)) / 3600.0) AS total_rental_hours
FROM rental r
JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
JOIN film_category fc ON i.film_id = fc.film_id
JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id
JOIN customer cust ON r.customer_id = cust.customer_id
JOIN address a ON cust.address_id = a.address_id

GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY total_rental_hours DESC
LIMIT 10"}

SELECT 
    c.name AS category_name,
    SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.return_date - r.rental_date)) / 3600.0) AS total_rental_hours
FROM rental r
JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
JOIN film_category fc ON i.film_id = fc.film_id
JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id
JOIN customer cust ON r.customer_id = cust.customer_id
JOIN address a ON cust.address_id = a.address_id
JOIN city ci ON a.city_id = ci.city_id
WHERE ci.city LIKE 'A%' OR ci.city LIKE '%-%'
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY total_rental_hours DESC
